# Part2D

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Part2D")`

A sprite with a physics body on the 2D plane; the 2D counterpart of a `Part`. It lies on the world's XY plane facing -Z, so an orthographic `Camera` looking along -Z sees it straight on. `ZIndex` orders sprites that overlap.

It is drawn as its `Image`, or as a flat `Color` if it has none. 2D physics simulates it unless it is `Anchored`, in which case it does not move.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Anchored` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the part is fixed in place. An anchored part is not moved by physics, and other parts rest on it. A script can still move it. |
| `AngularVelocity` | `number` | — | read/write | How fast the part rotates, in degrees per second, counterclockwise. |
| `CanCollide` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether other parts collide with this one. A part that does not collide is only drawn. |
| `CollisionGroup` | `string` | `"Default"` | read/write | The collision group that decides which other parts this one collides with, as defined in `PhysicsService`. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | A color the image is multiplied by. With no image, the part is drawn in this color. |
| `Density` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The density of the part, in kilograms per square meter. Together with `Size`, it sets the part's mass. |
| `Elasticity` | `number` | — | read/write | The fraction of its speed the part keeps when it bounces, from 0 (no bounce) to 1 (it bounces forever). |
| `ExactColor` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the sprite is drawn in exactly the colors of its image, bypassing exposure, tone mapping, color correction and bloom. On by default: a `Color` of `Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 40)` appears as exactly that color whatever `Lighting` is set to.<br><br>When it is off, the sprite is lit and processed like any part, which suits a sprite placed in a 3D scene. In both cases it is sorted by depth with the rest of the scene. |
| `Filter` | `Enum.TextureFilter` | — | read/write | How the image is sampled when it is scaled: `Linear` for painted art, `Nearest` for pixel art. |
| `FixedRotation` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the part is prevented from rotating, whatever hits it. Use it for a character that should stay upright. |
| `FlipX` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the image is mirrored left to right, for a character that faces the other way. |
| `FlipY` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the image is mirrored top to bottom. |
| `Friction` | `number` | `0.3` | read/write | How much the part grips a surface it slides on. 0 is like ice. |
| `GravityScale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much of `Workspace.Gravity` affects the part. At 0 it floats, at 2 it falls twice as hard, and with a negative value it falls upward. |
| `Image` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image the part is drawn as, stretched over `Size`. Transparent pixels of the image stay transparent. |
| `ImageRectOffset` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The top left corner of the part of the image to draw, in pixels. Use it to show one frame of a sprite sheet. |
| `ImageRectSize` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The size of the part of the image to draw, in pixels. Zero on both axes draws the whole image. |
| `Position` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The position of the part's center, in meters. |
| `Rotation` | `number` | — | read/write | The rotation of the part, in degrees counterclockwise. A part with `FixedRotation` on keeps this value. |
| `Sensor` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the part detects overlaps instead of colliding. A sensor fires `Touched` for what enters it and pushes nothing. Use it for a coin, a checkpoint or a trigger. |
| `Shape` | `Enum.Shape2D` | — | read/write | The outline the part is drawn with and collides as. |
| `Size` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(1, 1)` | read/write | The width and height of the part, in meters, for both the image and the collider. |
| `Transparency` | `number` | — | read/write | How transparent the part is, from 0 (as drawn) to 1 (invisible). A transparent part still collides. |
| `Velocity` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The velocity of the part, in meters per second. The simulation updates it every tick, and a script can set it: to jump, set its Y. |
| `ZIndex` | `number` | — | read/write | Which of two overlapping sprites is drawn in front: the one with the higher value. Sprites with equal values are drawn in tree order. |

## Methods

### `ApplyImpulse(impulse: Vector2)`

Applies an instant push at the part's center, in kilogram meters per second. It takes effect at the next simulation tick. An anchored part ignores it.

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `TouchEnded(otherPart: Instance)`

Fires when something that was touching the part stops touching it.

### `Touched(otherPart: Instance)`

Fires once when something starts touching the part: another `Part2D`, or the solid tiles of a `Tilemap2D`. For a `Sensor`, it fires when something starts overlapping it.
